newsitem.title: USA: Raytheon unit gets up to $40 mln in work.
newsitem.headline: Raytheon unit gets up to $40 mln in work.

text.p: Raytheon Co's Raytheon Engineers & Constructors unit said late Tuesday that one of its units has begun work on two contracts potentially totaling $40 million for the Army Corps of Engineers and the Air Force.
The first is from the Army Corps of Engineers to perform construction and maintenance work at Whiteman Air Force Base near Kansas City, Mo.
The second award is from the U.S. Air Force to perform similar work at F.E. Warren Air Force Base, near Cheyenne, Wyo.
The awards have a potential value of $20 million each over five years.
Raytheon Engineers & Constructors is one of the four business segments of Raytheon Co.
